title: Screams vs. Laughs
text:
Horror and comedy are two genres built to make us feel something: fear in one, laughter in the other. For my final project, I am studying the psychological pull of these genres. To start, I looked at how audiences actually respond to them, using ratings from 18,983 movies on IMDb.









Each point is one film. Movies further to the right drew more viewers, and movies higher up were rated more favorably.
